_comment: Two live forward-chained captures of Solana mainnet, 2026-10-20, by tools/chain/capture-sol-window.mjs driving codetracer-solana-recorder replay-stream.

UNSCOPED reads every account any non-vote transaction names. Free RPCs answer ~80 account calls a minute against a demand of ~35,000 new accounts a minute, so almost every transaction is refused prestate-unavailable; the few that run are BPF Upgradeable Loader buffer writes.

SCOPED reads only the accounts of transactions naming the listed programs (chosen by measured account reuse: bot programs touching a small fixed account set), warm-starts them before the window, and carries plain wallets and failed transactions across refusals using the chain recorded post-facts. Every transaction executed there agreed with every fact the chain recorded.
recorder is the codetracer-solana-recorder agents revision the scoped run used (the unscoped run predates its carry and unloadable-program changes).
